product_metadata.title: ANMINY 4PCS Natural Bamboo Wooden Storage Bins Set Desktop Basket Box Kitchen Food Container with Handles Decorative Clothes Baby Kids Nursey Laundry Closet Cabinet Shelf Large Small Drawer Organizer
features: Includes 4 pack bamboo storage bins, one of 11 x 6.3 x 4 in, one of 12.6 x 7.5 x 4.7 in, one of 13.8 x 8.7 x 5.5 in and one of 15 x 9.8 x 6.3 in.
Combining natural bamboo and wood, these storage bins are smooth yet pretty, sturdy and durable enough for long lasting use.
Built in handles on both sides for easy pick up/down or movement. Open top design provides a clear view, easy access and good ventilation for items inside.
Clear cut rectangular open storage bins will fit perfectly in your closet, shelf or other space. Corner dovetail joints form a sturdy construction that does not deform.
Classic solid color design and natural bamboo wood texture will satisfy all kinds of your home decoration. They can also be a lovely yet practical gift for friends and family.
